data.name: EscalateMultipleLimitExceededTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when the user selects more cases than the supported bulk escalation limit.

data.name: EscalateMultipleLimitExceededText
data.value: You can escalate a maximum of {maxCount} cases at a time. You selected {selectedCount}. Remove some cases and try again.
data.comment: Alert body shown when the user selects more cases than the supported bulk escalation limit. {Placeholder='{maxCount}'} is the maximum supported case count and {Placeholder='{selectedCount}'} is the number of selected cases.

data.name: EscalateMultiplePartialIssueTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when at least one selected case was compatible, but some selected cases were skipped or failed to escalate.

data.name: EscalateMultipleAllSkippedTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when all selected cases were skipped because none had an AI agent status record.

data.name: EscalateMultipleSkippedCasesText
data.value: Skipped cases without an AI Agent status record: {caseList}
data.comment: Section shown in the bulk escalation alert when selected cases are skipped because no AI agent status record was found. {Placeholder='{caseList}'} is the newline-delimited list of case numbers.

data.name: EscalateMultipleFailedCasesText
data.comment: Section shown in the bulk escalation alert when one or more compatible case escalation updates fail. {Placeholder='{caseList}'} is the newline-delimited list of case numbers.

data.name: EscalateMultipleSuccessCountZeroText
data.comment: Summary line shown at the top of the bulk escalation alert when no selected cases were successfully escalated.

data.name: EscalateMultipleSuccessCountSingularText
data.comment: Summary line shown at the top of the bulk escalation alert when exactly one case was successfully escalated. {Placeholder='{caseCount}'} is the number of cases successfully escalated.

data.name: EscalateMultipleSuccessCountPluralText
data.comment: Summary line shown at the top of the bulk escalation alert when multiple or zero cases were successfully escalated. {Placeholder='{caseCount}'} is the number of cases successfully escalated.

data.name: EscalateMultipleProgressMessage
data.comment: Message shown in the progress indicator while bulk escalation is in progress.

data.name: SupervisorLimitExceededTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when the user selects more cases than the supported bulk limit.

data.name: SupervisorLimitExceededText
data.value: You can stop a maximum of {maxCount} cases at a time. You selected {selectedCount}. Remove some cases and try again.
data.comment: Alert body shown when the user exceeds the bulk limit. {Placeholder='{maxCount}'} the maximum, {Placeholder='{selectedCount}'} the selected count.

data.name: SupervisorPartialIssueTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when at least one case was compatible but some were skipped or failed.

data.name: SupervisorAllSkippedTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when all selected cases were skipped (no applicable AI agent status record).

data.name: SupervisorSkippedCasesText
data.value: Skipped cases (no applicable AI Agent status): {caseList}
data.comment: Section shown when cases are skipped. {Placeholder='{caseList}'} is the newline-delimited list of case numbers.

data.name: SupervisorServerSkippedCasesText
data.value: Skipped cases (already stopped or not applicable): {caseList}
data.comment: Section shown when the server skipped cases that already have an AI agent status record (already stopped or not applicable). {Placeholder='{caseList}'} is the newline-delimited list of case numbers.

data.name: SupervisorFailedCasesText
data.comment: Section shown when one or more case updates fail. {Placeholder='{caseList}'} is the newline-delimited list of case numbers.

data.name: SupervisorSuccessCountZeroText
data.comment: Summary line when no cases succeeded.

data.name: SupervisorSuccessCountSingularText
data.comment: Summary line when exactly one case succeeded. {Placeholder='{caseCount}'} the count.

data.name: SupervisorSuccessCountPluralText
data.comment: Summary line when multiple cases succeeded. {Placeholder='{caseCount}'} the count.

data.name: SupervisorProgressMessage
data.comment: Message shown in the progress indicator while a bulk supervisor action is in progress.

data.name: SupervisorSingleProgressMessage
data.comment: Message shown in the progress indicator while a single-case stop action is in progress.

data.name: SupervisorSingleSuccess
data.comment: Confirmation shown after a single-case supervisor action succeeds.

data.name: SupervisorSingleSuccessTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown above the confirmation after a single-case stop succeeds.

data.name: SupervisorSingleFailure
data.value: The action could not be completed: {reason}
data.comment: Error shown after a single-case supervisor action fails. {Placeholder='{reason}'} is the localized server reason.

data.name: SupervisorSingleFailureTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown above the error message after a single-case stop fails.

data.name: SupervisorBulkSuccessTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when every selected case in a bulk supervisor action succeeded.

data.name: SupervisorSingleAlreadyStoppedTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when a single-case Stop was a no-op because the AI agent was already stopped.

data.name: SupervisorSingleAlreadyStoppedText
data.value: This case's AI Agent is already stopped, so no change was made.
data.comment: Alert body shown when a single-case Stop was a no-op because the AI agent was already stopped.

data.name: SupervisorSingleShadowTitle
data.value: AI Agent is in Shadow mode
data.comment: Alert title shown when a single-case Stop was a no-op because a person is already working the case.

data.name: SupervisorSingleShadowText
data.value: AI Agent cannot be stopped in Shadow mode.
data.comment: Alert body shown when a single-case Stop was a no-op because a person is already working the case.

data.name: SupervisorSingleNoStatusTitle
data.value: No active AI Agent to stop
data.comment: Alert title shown when a single-case Stop was skipped because the case has no active AI agent.

data.name: SupervisorSingleNoStatusText
data.value: This case doesn't have an active AI Agent, so there was nothing to stop.
data.comment: Alert body shown when a single-case Stop was skipped because the case has no active AI agent.

data.name: SupervisorSingleInProgressTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when a single-case Stop was a no-op because the AI agent is still working the case (InProgress).

data.name: SupervisorSingleInProgressText
data.value: This case's AI Agent is currently working on the case, so it can't be stopped right now. Try again once it finishes.
data.comment: Alert body shown when a single-case Stop was a no-op because the AI agent is still working the case (InProgress).

data.name: SupervisorSingleInactiveTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when a single-case Stop was skipped because the case is resolved or canceled (inactive).

data.name: SupervisorSingleInactiveText
data.value: This case is resolved or canceled. Reactivate it first.
data.comment: Alert body shown when a single-case Stop was skipped because the case is resolved or canceled (inactive).

data.name: SupervisorSingleNotAppliedTitle
data.comment: Alert title shown when a single-case Stop couldn't be applied and no change was made.

data.name: SupervisorSingleNotAppliedText
data.value: The stop action couldn't be applied to this case, so no change was made.
data.comment: Alert body shown when a single-case Stop couldn't be applied and no change was made.

data.name: SupervisorReasonInactiveCase
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the case was skipped because it is resolved or cancelled (inactive).

data.name: SupervisorReasonNoStatusRecord
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the case has no AI agent status record (AI agent not enabled).

data.name: SupervisorReasonIncompleteStatusRecord
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the case was skipped because its AI agent status record is incomplete or malformed.

data.name: SupervisorReasonFcsOff
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the case was skipped because the feature (feature control switch) is off.

data.name: SupervisorReasonIgnoredShadow
data.value: AI Agent is in Shadow mode
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the action was skipped because the AI agent is in Shadow mode.

data.name: SupervisorReasonAgentBusy
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the action was skipped because the AI agent is currently working (an in-progress run).

data.name: SupervisorReasonAlreadyStopped
data.comment: Per-case label in the bulk skipped list explaining the case was skipped because its AI agent was already stopped.
